reads.name: aliases
reads.input:
---
properties:
  A:
    type: select
    options: &opts
      - value: x
        color: red
  B:
    type: multiselect
    options: *opts
  U1:
    type: stars
    shared: &shared {k: [1, 2]}
  U2:
    type: stars
    shared: *shared
---
reads.rewritten:
---

  U1:
    type: stars
    shared: &ref_0
      k:
        - 1
        - 2
  U2:
    type: stars

  A:
    type: select
    options:
      - value: x
        color: red
  B:
    type: multiselect
    options:
      - value: x
        color: red
